title: Nvidia shares plunge 10% to June 2025 levels as Jensen Huang resigns
content: CFO Colette Kress takes over as interim CEO after Huang steps down immediately as president, chief executive and board member, sending shares down 10% to $156.

title: Ethereum researchers drop faster blocks to race toward quantum defenses in 2027
content: Ethlabs wants quantum-resistant accounts targeted for next year, even if wallet holders still have to switch signing methods themselves.

title: Bitcoin dips with Nvidia as ETF outflows reach day five
content: Bitcoin slips 0.7% as Nvidia falls on reports its board may oust CEO Jensen Huang, while U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lose another $299.9 million.

title: Jensen Huang resigns as NVIDIA CEO and board member
content: Colette Kress will remain Nvidia’s chief financial officer while serving as interim CEO as the board searches for a permanent successor.

title: Bit Digital stock falls 5% in pre-market after Q3 revenue miss
content: Bit Digital’s $27 million third-quarter revenue came in 16% below analyst consensus estimates, marking an over $5 million shortfall.

title: Thailand proposes $148K daily cap on stablecoin deposits and withdrawals
content: Thailand’s SEC would set separate daily caps for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals and require customers to use wallets they own.

title: Crypto hack losses equal 57 cents per $1 earned onchain: Ark’s Valente
content: Crypto hackers stole $8.7 billion so far in 2026, surpassing the projected annual onchain revenue generated across the industry, according to ARK’s research director.

title: Are Alt-L1s over? Security, costs drive smaller chains to Ethereum
content: L1 blockchains Zilliqa, Gnosis and Ronin join the Ethereum ecosystem as the costs of going it alone grow, and the security and liquidity advantages become too hard to resist.

title: SoFi Brings Its Bank-Issued Stablecoin to Polygon’s Payments Stack
content: SoFiUSD, the first stablecoin from a U.S. national bank, is now live on Polygon Open Money Stack alongside Ethereum and Solana.

title: DTCC to Bring Tokenized Stocks and Treasuries to Solana in 2027
content: Wall Street's main settlement firm will add Solana to its tokenization service, which went live last month on Canton and a private network.

title: India's Financial Crimes Agency Searches CoinDCX, Delta Exchange Over Offshore Trades
content: The Enforcement Directorate alleges the exchanges routed Indian users' trades to Binance, Bybit and others via a Costa Rican shell entity.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $1.4B in Five Days as Investors Cut Risk
content: U.S. spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds have recorded five consecutive days of net outflows, as investors retreat from risk assets after a turbulent week for markets. title: MSCI Removes Strategy (MSTR) From Its USA Index, Forcing Index Funds to Sell by Nov. 30
content: Bitcoin Magazine MSCI Removes Strategy (MSTR) From Its USA Index, Forcing Index Funds to Sell by Nov. 30 MSCI will take Strategy, Metaplanet, Yellow Cake, Skel and Upexi out of its global indexes as of the Nov. 30 close, after a new screen classified them as non-operating companies. This post MSCI Removes Strategy (MSTR) From Its USA Index, Forcing Index Funds to Sell by Nov. 30 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: How Sam Altman-Backed Meanwhile Is Disrupting the $20T Life Insurance Industry
content: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine How Sam Altman-Backed Meanwhile Is Disrupting the $20T Life Insurance Industry Danny Baer, Head of Revenue & Investments at Meanwhile, explains how his Bermuda-based company built the world's first fully licensed life insurance carrier that runs entirely on Bitcoin, holding its regulatory capital in Bitcoin and paying out policies in Bitcoin. This post How Sam Altman-Backed Meanwhile Is Disrupting the $20T Life Insurance Industry first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
